work.text: In Goltzius's print, which was so popular it was reprinted as late as the 19th century, the central male figure is Demogorgon, the omnipotent father of all gods.

source.author: Cleveland Museum of Art
source.title: The Deities: Demogorgon in the Cave of Eternity

moment.text: Not all witches were women; men also performed magic. Unlike the destructive and sexualized stereotypes of female witches, male magicians were likened to the philosophers, alchemists, or heroic scientists of the Renaissance.

source.author: Cleveland Museum of Art
source.title: The Deities: Demogorgon in the Cave of Eternity

matters.text: Although Demogorgon was feared as the "Demon-gorgon," a terror who could unleash his primordial power, Goltzius portrays the god as a wizened and magical force who uses his power to give form to the world.

source.author: Cleveland Museum of Art
